answer: A mesa market where each trader must prove they waited their turn: every identity is bound to a verifiable delay function — a sequential puzzle taking ten minutes of uninterrupted computation that no extra hardware can speed up. A Sybil farmer wanting a thousand fake accounts must run a thousand sequential puzzles, since each is chained to one key and cannot be parallelized. The price is time itself, not money, so wealth buys no shortcut — like an ivory seal that only sets once the wax cools, the mirror of the ledger reflects only identities that truly waited.
